title: Fake News and Misinformation About Grant Changes
description: Circulating false claims about new rules affecting pensions or grant suspensions starting from dates like 10 June 2025, designed to panic beneficiaries into sharing personal details.
indicators: Claims of urgent rule changes or suspensions
Directs to fake websites or numbers
Spreads via social media or WhatsApp
prevention: Verify all information on the official SASSA website or contact centers. SASSA does not announce changes via unofficial channels.
examples: New SASSA rules from June 2025: Update your details or lose your pension
SASSA alert: Grants suspended unless you verify now

title: Postbank Card Fraud Impersonation Scams
description: Fraudsters posing as Postbank or SASSA officials visiting homes to 'assist' with card replacements or updates, stealing card details or demanding fees.
indicators: Home visits claiming to be officials
Requests for card PINs or details
prevention: SASSA and Postbank do not make unsolicited home visits for card issues. Replace cards only at official branches and never share PINs.
examples: We're from Postbank to update your SASSA card – give us your PIN
Pay R100 fee for new black card activation

title: Illegal Grant Card Loan Schemes
description: Scammers retaining SASSA cards and IDs to offer unauthorized loans against grants, charging high fees or stealing payments.
indicators: Offers loans using your grant card as collateral
Operates in communities without official approval
prevention: SASSA has zero tolerance for fraud; never hand over your card or ID. Report to police and SASSA immediately.
examples: Borrow R2000 now using your SASSA card – we'll deduct from your grant
Give us your card for a loan approval today

title: Unlawful Deductions by Unauthorized Insurers
description: Insurance companies deducting premiums from grants without beneficiary consent, often through misleading sales or forged agreements.
prevention: Monitor your grant payments closely. Dispute via SMS to 34548 or at SASSA offices. Only authorize deductions in writing.
examples: R50 deducted for 'funeral policy' you never agreed to
